doc.name: webAI
doc.description: webAI empowers businesses to harness the power of AI directly on their own devices, eliminating the need for cloud infrastructure and ensuring complete data privacy. With a focus on enterprise-grade applications, webAI enables companies to build, deploy, and control advanced AI models. By leveraging existing hardware, webAI offers cost-effective, scalable solutions that keep data secure, reduce operational costs, and deliver real-time insights—even offline.

doc.name: Suno
doc.description: Suno is an AI music generation startup that allows users to create original songs with AI. The company’s platform enables users to generate custom music by providing text prompts or musical parameters. Suno’s technology combines deep learning models with music theory to produce high-quality, royalty-free tracks for various applications.

doc.name: Flyfin
doc.description: Flyfin is an AI-powered tax preparation and filing service. This fintech startup combines the expertise of real certified public accountants (CPAs) and AI to provide an expedited, automated tax solution for self-employed individuals.

doc.name: Cohere
doc.description: Cohere provides natural language processing (NLP) models to improve human-machine interactions. The company aims to differentiate itself by focusing on developers who need easy-to-use language tools for more than one task and by allowing companies to bring their own language data tailored to their industry.

doc.name: Kore.ai
doc.description: Kore.ai is an enterprise AI platform that specializes in conversational AI and process automation. The company offers a range of AI-powered solutions (e.g., virtual assistants, chatbots, and intelligent process automation tools) for businesses across various industries. Kore.ai’s platform aims to enhance customer experiences, streamline operations, and drive digital transformation for organizations.

doc.name: Overjet
doc.description: Overjet uses Food and Drug Administration (FDA)-cleared AI technology to help dental providers enhance clinical care and administrative efficiency. The company’s patient-centric platform leverages machine learning (ML), computer vision, and NLP to increase diagnosis precision, treatment accuracy, and practice automation.

doc.name: Glide
doc.description: Glide is a platform that allows users to create mobile and web applications without coding. It enables people to transform data from spreadsheets into fully functional apps through a user-friendly, drag-and-drop interface. With Glide, individuals and businesses can quickly build custom apps for various purposes, including inventory management, customer databases, and project tracking.

doc.name: Realworld
doc.description: The Realworld app is a game-changing innovation for the next generation of adults. With this easy-to-use app, Realworld provides resources and tools that help young adults to navigate adulthood in nearly every way. From tax filing assistance to everything users need to know about getting their first pet, Realworld lays the foundation for organization and success.

doc.name: So Syncd
doc.description: So Syncd is a sister-founded startup that’s changing the way consumers use dating apps. Leveraging the 16 Myers-Briggs personality types, So Syncd pairs users up based on the compatibility of their personalities. This involves an advanced algorithm rather than swiping left and right based on physical appearance alone.

doc.name: Heetch
doc.description: Heetch is a ride-sharing app geared toward late-night transportation as an alternative to taxis. By offering low commission fees, transparent prices and destinations, and lower prices for customers, Heetch is effectively taking on ride-share giants across the globe.

doc.name: Snappr
doc.description: Snappr is the one-stop shop for companies who need content created. This startup provides comprehensive software that organizes photo shoots, provides stock photos and editing capabilities, and more. Users are even allowed to create workflows for their visual content, and the service integrates with almost any existing platform.

doc.name: Wonolo
doc.description: Wonolo transforms the recruiting process for companies by providing a centralized place for businesses and potential employees. Through Wonolo, companies don’t have to mess around with interviews or resumes. Instead, all employees are vetted by Wonolo and available through the company’s app.

doc.name: Touchland
doc.description: Touchland is a modern hand sanitizer company that reimagines personal hygiene products. The company offers sleek, portable hand sanitizer dispensers with moisturizing formulas in various scents. Touchland’s products aim to make hand sanitizing a more enjoyable and stylish experience while effectively killing germs.

doc.name: Kinship
doc.description: Kinship is a clean and sustainable skin care line that aims to deliver effective and ethical skin care products that boast certifications from the Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) and Ocean Waste Plastic (OWP). In addition, each product is cruelty-free, genetically modified organism (GMO)-free, reef-safe, and comes in packaging made of post-consumer recycled materials.

doc.name: Crown Affair
doc.description: Crown Affair is a hair care brand focused on elevating daily hair rituals with high-quality, sustainable products. The company offers a curated selection of brushes, combs, oils, and other hair accessories designed for gentle, effective care. Crown Affair emphasizes mindful hair maintenance and promotes a slower, more intentional approach to hair care.

doc.name: Eight Sleep
doc.description: Eight Sleep is a sleep fitness company that produces smart mattresses and sleep tracking technology. The company’s flagship product, the Pod, is a temperature-controlled mattress that adjusts throughout the night for optimal sleep conditions. Eight Sleep uses AI and biometric data to provide personalized sleep insights and recommendations for improving sleep quality.

doc.name: Open
doc.description: Open is a modern wellness company that combines physical studios with digital content for a holistic approach to mindfulness and fitness. The company offers in-person classes as well as an app that features guided meditations, breathwork exercises, and movement sessions. Open aims to create a community-driven wellness experience that integrates mental, physical, and spiritual practices.

doc.name: by Humankind
doc.description: Sustainable personal goods startup by Humankind is dedicated to reducing single-use plastics in consumers’ daily lives. The company’s innovative personal care products range from mouthwash tablets to shampoo bars — all boasting clean ingredients and an impactful refill model to reduce waste.

doc.name: ClearForMe
doc.description: Created for those struggling with skin allergies, ClearForMe is a beauty tech startup that partners with beauty giants like Ulta and Credo to make shopping for cosmetics and skin care safer for consumers with allergies.

doc.name: Drift
doc.description: Drift is a decentralized exchange protocol built on the Solana blockchain, focusing on perpetual futures trading. It utilizes an on-chain order book and advanced risk management systems to offer low-latency, capital-efficient trading. Drift aims to provide a user-friendly trading experience while maintaining the benefits of decentralization, such as non-custodial trading and transparent on-chain settlement.

doc.name: Anchorage Digital
doc.description: Anchorage Digital is a cryptocurrency custody and trading platform designed for institutional investors. The company offers secure storage solutions for digital assets, combining cold storage security with the accessibility of hot wallets. Anchorage Digital also provides additional services, such as staking, governance, and financing, aiming to be a comprehensive solution for institutions entering the crypto space.

doc.name: Tenderly
doc.description: Tenderly offers a blockchain development platform that provides tools for building, testing, and monitoring smart contracts. The company’s suite of products includes a Web3 gateway, simulation platform, and real-time alerting system for blockchain transactions. Tenderly’s goal is to simplify the development process for Ethereum and other Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM)-compatible blockchains, making it easier for developers to create and maintain decentralized applications.

doc.name: Spring Labs
doc.description: With Spring Labs’ platform, users can expect faster and more secure information exchange due to the startup’s leveraging of blockchain transparency and data collection capabilities. Spring Labs reduces fraud by increasing verified identities and prioritizing the protection of consumer data.

doc.name: Braintrust
doc.description: Braintrust is a decentralized talent network that connects skilled professionals with companies seeking their expertise. It operates on a blockchain-based platform, using its native BTRST token to incentivize network growth and governance. Braintrust’s model aims to eliminate any middleman, allowing talent to keep 100% of their earnings while clients pay lower fees compared to traditional staffing agencies.

doc.name: Stably
doc.description: Stably is a fintech company that specializes in creating stablecoins and other blockchain-based financial products. The company aims to bridge the gap between traditional finance and cryptocurrencies by offering solutions like the United States Digital Service (USDS), a US dollar (USD)-pegged stablecoin. Stably’s services include stablecoin issuance, blockchain integration, and digital asset management for both individuals and enterprises.

doc.name: Abnormal Security
doc.description: This email security company leverages the power of AI to protect companies from targeted email attacks. Using behavioral profiling, Abnormal Security’s software can effectively predict and detect illegitimate emails.

doc.name: Torq
doc.description: Torq offers a no-code security automation platform that enables organizations to streamline their security operations. It allows security teams to create, customize, and deploy automated workflows across their entire security infrastructure without requiring coding skills. Torq’s platform integrates with existing security tools and provides pre-built templates to help companies respond faster to security incidents and reduce manual tasks.

doc.name: Persona
doc.description: Persona is an identity verification and Know Your Customer (KYC) platform that helps businesses verify the identity of their users securely and efficiently. It offers a range of verification methods, including document verification, biometric matching, and database checks, to create a flexible and customizable identity verification process. Persona’s solution is designed to help companies comply with regulations, prevent fraud, and build trust with their customers while maintaining a smooth user experience.

doc.name: Silverfort
doc.description: Silverfort provides an agentless authentication and zero-trust platform that secures access across corporate networks and cloud environments. It uses AI-based risk analysis to enforce adaptive authentication and access policies for all users, devices, and resources without requiring software agents or modifications to existing systems. Silverfort’s solution helps organizations protect against identity-based attacks, enforce least-privilege access, and achieve compliance with various regulations.

doc.name: Drata
doc.description: Drata helps companies achieve and maintain compliance through its user-friendly software. The company’s security automation platform streamlines audits and certifications like Systems and Organization Controls 2 (SOC 2), International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 27001, and more with its robust cloud platform.

doc.name: Verishop
doc.description: Verishop is an online marketplace that curates a selection of everyday luxury brands for everything from fashion and beauty to home and more. Quality products are the backbone of this startup, which aims to become the go-to online marketplace for lifestyle goods.

doc.name: Whatnot
doc.description: Whatnot is a livestream shopping platform that’s changing the game for interactive ecommerce. It’s a community-driven marketplace that turns shopping into an event where buyers can discover and purchase collectibles in real time.

doc.name: Maisonette
doc.description: Maisonette is a curated online marketplace that specializes in high-end children’s clothing, accessories, and home decor. The platform brings together a carefully selected assortment of both established and emerging brands, catering to style-conscious parents looking for unique, quality items for their children. Maisonette aims to simplify the shopping experience for parents by offering a one-stop destination for premium children’s products.

doc.name: Flowspace
doc.description: Flowspace is a technology-driven fulfillment platform that provides on-demand warehousing and logistics services for ecommerce businesses. The company connects retailers with a network of warehouses across the country, allowing for flexible inventory management and faster shipping times. Flowspace’s software optimizes order routing and inventory distribution, helping businesses scale their operations efficiently.

doc.name: Pattern
doc.description: Pattern Brands (Pattern) is a holding company that creates and acquires direct-to-consumer brands focused on home essentials. The company’s strategy involves building a portfolio of complementary brands that share operational efficiencies and cross-selling opportunities. Pattern Brands aims to simplify the home goods market by offering curated, high-quality products that enhance everyday living.

doc.name: FERMAT
doc.description: FERMAT is an innovative ecommerce platform that leverages AI to personalize the online shopping experience. The company uses advanced ML algorithms to analyze customer behavior and preferences, providing tailored product recommendations and customized user interfaces. FERMAT aims to increase conversion rates and customer satisfaction by creating a unique shopping journey for each individual user.

doc.name: MagicSchool
doc.description: MagicSchool is a leading AI platform for education, renowned for its widespread adoption and user satisfaction among educators globally. It empowers teachers with AI-assisted tools for comprehensive educational tasks, including lesson planning, differentiated instruction, assessment creation, individualized education program (IEP) development, and enhanced communication. MagicSchool has expanded its offering with MagicSchool for Students, introducing responsible AI experiences to classrooms and fostering AI literacy in the next generation of learners.

doc.name: Jolt
doc.description: Jolt is a workforce education platform that compiles a network of learning spaces intended to provide users with business training and useful skills. Each lesson is short and impactful, making courses accessible to professionals and students alike.

doc.name: Sana Labs
doc.description: Sana Labs uses AI to create an innovative learning experience that prioritizes personal learning needs in order to effectively deliver training and courses to teams. By creating training programs rooted in science and tailored to the students, Sana Labs provides impactful education on a wide range of subjects for startup companies and their teams.

doc.name: Campus
doc.description: Campus provides an innovative online platform that offers an alternative to traditional higher education while arming students with an associate’s degree in an array of subjects. This digital-first institution delivers a comprehensive curriculum designed to equip students with practical skills and knowledge relevant to today’s job market. Campus combines flexible scheduling, industry-partnered coursework, and personalized learning pathways to provide an accessible and career-focused educational experience for students seeking a more direct route to employment or further education.

doc.name: Praktika.ai
doc.description: Praktika.ai is an advanced AI avatar language tutoring platform that revolutionizes personalized learning experiences. It utilizes sophisticated AI to create lifelike virtual tutors capable of adapting to each student’s unique learning style and pace. Praktika.ai’s AI avatars offer interactive, one-on-one tutoring sessions that provide students with engaging, on-demand educational support they can access anytime, anywhere.

doc.name: Newsela
doc.description: Newsela helps teachers and education institutions provide modern educational content for English Language Arts (ELA), social studies, and science. The content can quickly be approved by the educational system because it follows all statewide requirements for curriculum.

doc.name: Trove
doc.description: Trove is a circular fashion platform that partners with brands to enable resale of their products. The company provides technology and operations to power trade-in and resale programs for clothing brands. Trove aims to extend the lifecycle of clothing items and reduce waste in the fashion industry.

doc.name: Daydream
doc.description: Daydream is a highly personalized shopping experience powered by a built-in, superhuman search engine. The company integrates cutting-edge generative AI, machine learning, and computer vision to transform every step of the shopping journey—starting with search and discovery. Daydream’s mission is to offer a better way to find and discover women’s and men’s fashion and build the largest high-quality branded catalog online.

doc.name: By Rotation
doc.description: By Rotation is a peer-to-peer fashion rental app that allows users to lend and borrow designer clothing and accessories. The platform aims to promote sustainable fashion by encouraging sharing rather than the constant buying of new items. By Rotation also fosters a community of fashion enthusiasts who can connect and share their style.

doc.name: Revive
doc.description: Revive focuses on upcycling and repurposing pre-loved clothing items. The company collects and transforms discarded garments into new, fashionable pieces, giving them a second life. Revive’s mission is to reduce textile waste and promote creativity in sustainable fashion.

doc.name: Unspun
doc.description: Unspun is a technology-driven custom jeans company that creates made-to-order denim using 3D body scanning and weaving technology. Unspun’s process eliminates inventory waste by producing jeans only when ordered, ensuring a perfect fit for each customer. The company aims to reduce overproduction in the fashion industry while providing personalized, sustainable clothing.

doc.name: Daffy
doc.description: Daffy is a not-for-profit fintech reimagining the donor-advised fund. With Daffy, users can easily invest in donor-advised funds for a surprisingly low amount of capital.

doc.name: Mercury
doc.description: Mercury is a digital banking platform designed specifically for growing startups. Backed by advanced security measures and integrations with popular business tools, Mercury is poised to revolutionize the way entrepreneurs manage their finances.

doc.name: Melio
doc.description: Melio is a business-to-business (B2B) payments platform that helps small businesses and their suppliers simplify the process of paying and getting paid. The company’s solution enables businesses to transfer and receive payments using various methods, including bank transfers, debit cards, and paper checks. Melio’s goal is to provide an easy-to-use, flexible payment system that improves cash flow management for small businesses.

doc.name: Capchase
doc.description: Capchase helps other startups secure non-dilutive capital through recurring revenue financing. By providing flexible cash flow to high-growth companies, Capchase allows founders to take control of their fundraising timeline.

doc.name: Coast
doc.description: Coast offers a fuel card and fleet management platform for small to medium-sized businesses. The company’s solution combines a physical Visa card with a mobile app and web dashboard to help companies track and control fuel spending. Coast aims to simplify expense management for fleets while providing insights to optimize operations and reduce costs.

doc.name: Propel
doc.description: Propel is a fintech company that developed the Fresh EBT app, which helps low-income Americans manage their food stamps — also known as Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) — benefits. The app allows users to check their electronic benefits transfer (EBT) card balance, find nearby stores that accept food stamps, and access money-saving deals and resources. Propel’s mission is to build modern, user-friendly technology for low-income Americans to improve financial health and access to social services.

doc.name: Greenlight
doc.description: Greenlight offers a debit card and app designed to help parents teach their children about money management. The platform allows parents to automate allowances, set spending controls, and incentivize saving through parent-paid interest rates. Greenlight aims to promote financial literacy among kids and teens while giving parents tools to oversee and guide their children’s spending and saving habits.

doc.name: Kosterina
doc.description: Kosterina offers a line of food, wellness, and beauty products centered around top-tier olive oil available in retailers like Whole Foods and Crate & Barrel. In addition to its central product line, this startup also offers vinegars and other assorted food items.

doc.name: Formo
doc.description: Formo is pioneering animal-free dairy products. The company uses precision fermentation to produce real milk proteins without involving animals in the process. Formo aims to create sustainable, ethical cheese and other dairy products that are indistinguishable from traditional dairy in taste and texture.

doc.name: Voyage Foods
doc.description: Voyage Foods is focused on recreating beloved food products using sustainable and ethical ingredients. The company works on developing alternatives to products like chocolate, coffee, and peanut butter that are free from common allergens and environmental concerns. Voyage aims to make these familiar foods more accessible and sustainable without compromising on taste or quality.

doc.name: OLIPOP
doc.description: OLIPOP is a beverage company that produces functional sodas designed to support digestive health. The company’s drinks combine the familiar flavors of classic sodas with prebiotics, botanicals, and plant fibers to create a low-sugar, gut-friendly alternative to traditional soft drinks. OLIPOP aims to revolutionize the soda industry by offering healthier options that don’t sacrifice taste.

doc.name: Infinite Roots
doc.description: Infinite Roots is a food technology startup that develops sustainable protein alternatives using mushroom mycelium. The company harnesses the power of fungal networks to create meat-like textures and flavors in its plant-based products. Infinite Roots aims to provide environmentally friendly and nutritious food options that can help reduce the world’s reliance on animal agriculture.

doc.name: Savor
doc.description: Savor is a food technology company that specializes in creating plant-based fats, starting with butter. The company uses innovative techniques to develop natural, clean-label ingredients that can replicate or enhance umami and other complex taste profiles in plant-based foods. Savor’s products aim to improve the taste and appeal of plant-based meals, making it easier for consumers to adopt more sustainable eating habits.

doc.name: Rula
doc.description: Rula is a digital mental health platform designed to improve access to — and the quality of — mental health care. The company offers virtual therapy sessions, personalized treatment plans, and digital tools to support individuals in managing their mental health. Rula aims to make mental health care more accessible, convenient, and effective by leveraging technology to connect patients with mental health professionals and provide ongoing support.

doc.name: Parsley Health
doc.description: Parsley Health is an innovative take on modern healthcare and primary care. By offering a platform that integrates cutting-edge medical testing and technology as well as impactful nutrition, wellness, and prevention research, Parsley Health provides customers with a holistic medical experience.

doc.name: Helaina
doc.description: Helaina is a biotechnology startup that specializes in creating human milk proteins through precision fermentation. The company’s goal is to produce breast milk alternatives that closely mimic the nutritional composition and benefits of human breast milk. Helaina’s innovative approach aims to provide infants with a more natural and beneficial alternative to traditional formula.

doc.name: Midi Health
doc.description: Midi Health is a virtual care clinic dedicated to providing comprehensive healthcare for women experiencing perimenopause and menopause. The company offers telemedicine consultations, personalized treatment plans, and ongoing support from specialized healthcare providers. Midi Health aims to address the often-overlooked health needs of women in midlife, offering them evidence-based care and education.

doc.name: AminoChain
doc.description: AminoChain offers an innovative platform that connects global inventories of biosamples and research data, facilitating the advancement of pre-clinical research economies. The company enables users to query sample and data collections while allowing contributors to maintain ownership of their assets and intellectual property. By providing this interconnected network, AminoChain fosters collaboration among researchers and institutions to streamline the process of accessing valuable biological resources and data for scientific research.

doc.name: Candid Health
doc.description: Candid Health aims to simplify and streamline the medical billing process for healthcare providers and patients. The company offers a platform that automates insurance verification, claim submission, and payment processing thereby reducing administrative burdens and improving financial outcomes for healthcare practices. Candid Health’s solution is designed to increase transparency in healthcare costs and improve the overall patient financial experience.

doc.name: Pivot
doc.description: Pivot, formerly known as Carrot, is a digital health startup taking on smoking cessation with a behavioral and data-driven approach.

doc.name: Skylo
doc.description: Skylo aims to provide affordable, satellite-based, narrowband IoT solutions. The company leverages existing geostationary satellites to offer IoT connectivity in remote and underserved areas where traditional cellular networks are unavailable. Skylo’s technology enables various applications, such as asset tracking, fleet management, and agricultural monitoring, in challenging environments.

doc.name: Seeq
doc.description: Seeq provides fast, easily derived business insights from industrial data and analytics. By transforming data gathered from the industrial process, businesses can make educated business decisions, increase revenue, and build better products.

doc.name: Artisight
doc.description: Artisight specializes in creating intelligent hospital environments. The company uses computer vision and sensor technology to improve operational efficiency and patient care in healthcare settings. Artisight’s solutions include real-time location tracking, automated hand hygiene monitoring, and predictive analytics for patient flow optimization.

doc.name: Infraspeak
doc.description: Infraspeak works to streamline and optimize the facilities management industry by providing an intelligent, maintenance-management platform. Through the platform, users can develop solutions for their teams that’ll result in better services rendered and a more streamlined approach to business operations.

doc.name: Zypp Electric
doc.description: Zypp Electric operates an electric vehicle-as-a-service platform that aims to produce zero emissions and make India carbon-free for last-mile deliveries. The company’s fleet of IoT and AI-enabled electric scooters provide sustainable, emission-free delivery services for businesses while reducing costs and pollution through automated battery swapping.

doc.name: Cowboy
doc.description: Cowboy is an electric bike manufacturer known for its sleek, minimalist designs and smart technology integration. The company’s ebikes feature built-in GPS tracking, automatic crash detection, and a mobile app for navigation and bike control. Cowboy aims to make urban commuting more efficient and enjoyable by offering a high-tech, eco-friendly alternative to cars and public transportation.

doc.name: FERNRIDE
doc.description: FERNRIDE develops teleoperation technology for autonomous vehicles. The company focuses on creating remote operation systems that allow human drivers to control vehicles from a distance, bridging the gap between current transportation methods and fully autonomous solutions. FERNRIDE’s technology is particularly applicable in industries like logistics, agriculture, and construction where it can improve safety and efficiency.

doc.name: Alto
doc.description: Alto is a luxury ride-hailing company that offers a premium, membership-based transportation service. Unlike traditional ride-sharing apps, Alto employs its drivers and maintains a fleet of luxury vehicles to ensure a consistent, high-quality experience for passengers. The company emphasizes safety, comfort, and personalization, allowing members to customize their ride preferences through a mobile app.

doc.name: Beam
doc.description: Beam is a micromobility startup that offers shared electric scooters and other personal mobility devices. The company operates in several countries in more than 60 cities across the Asia Pacific region, providing eco-friendly last-mile transportation solutions in urban areas. Beam focuses on safety and responsible riding, incorporating features like virtual parking docks, rider education programs, and advanced GPS technology to ensure proper vehicle usage and storage.

doc.name: aifleet
doc.description: aifleet is a logistics startup that aims to revolutionize the trucking industry through automation and AI. The company developed a fleet of semiautonomous trucks and an AI-powered dispatching system to optimize routes and improve efficiency in long-haul transportation. aifleet’s goal is to address driver shortages and reduce operational costs while enhancing safety in the trucking sector.

doc.name: felmo
doc.description: felmo provides a variety of veterinary services for pets from the comfort of customers’ homes. By offering fast, flexible, and affordable scheduling as well as a stress-free veterinary experience for pets, felmo is changing the way pet owners care for their pets’ health.

doc.name: Embark
doc.description: Embark is a dog DNA testing company that provides genetic insights for canine health and breed identification. The company offers comprehensive genetic screening for more than 200 health conditions and traits, helping dog owners and breeders make informed decisions about their pets’ care. Embark also contributes to canine genetics research by building a database of dog DNA profiles.

doc.name: FirstVet
doc.description: FirstVet is a telehealth platform that connects pet owners with licensed veterinarians for on-demand video consultations. The service allows pet owners to get professional advice for non-emergency issues, triage potential health concerns, and determine if an in-person vet visit is necessary. FirstVet aims to improve access to veterinary care, reduce unnecessary clinic visits, and provide peace of mind to pet owners.

doc.name: Loyal
doc.description: Loyal develops medicines to help dogs live longer and healthier lives. Composed of a team of veterinarians, scientists, and dog-lovers, this startup aims to produce the first drugs to combat the negative effects of aging in dogs.

doc.name: PLACE
doc.description: PLACE offers a technology and business services platform designed to empower top real estate professionals. The company provides agents with a comprehensive suite of tools, including marketing support, business coaching, and back-office management, to help streamline operations and boost productivity. By offering a revenue-sharing model and emphasizing agent success, PLACE aims to revolutionize how high-performing real estate professionals run their businesses.

doc.name: HomeLight
doc.description: HomeLight is transforming the home buying and selling process by creating a central platform where all transactions can occur. Homeowners are able to easily find the right listing agent on the platform while other customers can utilize a myriad of other resources designed for elders and agents.

doc.name: Snapdocs
doc.description: With the recent surge in competition for houses, Snapdocs is making it easy for homebuyers to get the house of their dreams as quickly as possible. Snapdocs doesn’t just make mortgage forms available online, the company connects all parties involved in the closing process via a digital closing platform to help enhance communication and efficiency.

doc.name: Homeward
doc.description: Homeward is a home-buying platform that aims to empower both the agent and buyer to make cash offers, negotiate prices, and even establish move-in dates on their own terms. Homeward offers support for selling and buying properties that benefit both home buyers and sellers to make the best deal possible.

doc.name: Systematic
doc.description: The AI-powered platform Systematic democratizes fundraising opportunities by connecting startups and investors. Leveraging ML and extensive data, it offers tools to analyze markets, showcase profiles, and share information securely.

doc.name: Firstbase
doc.description: Firstbase is an all-in-one business operations platform designed to help founders launch, manage, and grow their startups. With its comprehensive platform, Firstbase is enabling entrepreneurs worldwide to efficiently handle essential operations like incorporation, banking, payroll, accounting, and more.

doc.name: Upmetrics
doc.description: Upmetrics is an all-in-one business planning software that combines actionable planning, real-time forecasting, and insightful reporting. The platform offers AI-powered tools to help entrepreneurs and small businesses create comprehensive business plans, financial forecasts, and pitch decks.

doc.name: Bolster
doc.description: Bolster is a marketplace for executive hiring, offering services to connect startups with C-suite roles on a fractional, interim, advisory, or full-time basis.

doc.name: Tropic
doc.description: Tropic is a software procurement platform revolutionizing purchasing through data-driven spend management. By providing unprecedented visibility into pricing, alternatives, and trends, Tropic enables businesses to optimize spending efficiency and productivity.

doc.name: Hummingbird
doc.description: Hummingbird operates a compliance management platform designed to strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing (CTF) investigations. The company’s solution streamlines processes by reducing paperwork, offering insightful analytics, and facilitating collaboration between compliance professionals and law enforcement agencies. By providing these tools, Hummingbird empowers organizations to effectively defend against cyber-financial crimes and maintain regulatory compliance.

doc.name: Ambercycle
doc.description: Ambercycle is a materials science company that has developed a technology to recycle end-of-life textiles into new fibers. The company’s process breaks down polyester fabrics at the molecular level, allowing them to be reformed into high-quality recycled materials. By creating a circular economy for textiles, Ambercycle aims to reduce waste in the fashion industry and decrease reliance on virgin, petroleum-based materials.

doc.name: BrightNight
doc.description: BrightNight is pioneering renewable power solutions for businesses seeking to transition away from fossil fuels. The company’s customized hybrid renewable energy projects help customers meet sustainability goals reliably and cost-effectively.

doc.name: Captura
doc.description: Captura is a climate tech startup focused on removing carbon dioxide directly from seawater. The company’s innovative technology mimics the ocean’s natural carbon cycle, extracting CO2 and returning the depleted seawater back to the ocean. By targeting the world’s largest carbon sink, Captura aims to scale up carbon removal efforts to help combat climate change.

doc.name: Hempitecture
doc.description: Hempitecture is a sustainable insulation startup that specializes in HempWool®, an insulation alternative made with roughly 90% hemp fiber and 10% binder. The fiber used in Hempitecture products is farmed in the United States and Canada in an effort to capture carbon dioxide from the air, resulting in products that are better for the planet and people alike.

doc.name: Mighty Buildings
doc.description: Mighty Buildings is a construction technology company that uses 3D printing and robotic automation to build energy-efficient homes. The company produces modular housing units with minimal waste, utilizing proprietary materials that are lightweight and durable. The company aims to address housing shortages while reducing the environmental impact of traditional construction methods.

doc.name: Point.me
doc.description: Point.me is a platform that helps travelers find and book flights using their credit card points and airline miles. It simplifies the complex process of award travel by searching across multiple loyalty programs and presenting the best redemption options. The service aims to maximize the value of users’ points and miles, potentially saving them thousands of dollars on flights.

doc.name: The Hotels Network
doc.description: The Hotels Network provides a platform that serves as a method of growth for hotels using technology to attract and convert online visitors to paying customers by creating a unique, personalized, and predictive user experience.

doc.name: Fora
doc.description: Fora is a modern travel agency that combines the expertise of human travel advisors with cutting-edge technology. It empowers travel enthusiasts to become professional travel agents, providing them with training, tools, and support to build their own travel businesses. Fora advisors offer personalized trip planning services to clients while earning commissions and enjoying perks typically reserved for traditional travel agents.

doc.name: Mindtrip
doc.description: Mindtrip is an AI-powered travel planning assistant that creates personalized itineraries based on users’ preferences and interests. It analyzes vast amounts of travel data, including user reviews, local events, and attractions, to suggest unique experiences tailored to each traveler.
